messages:
sara-people-ops: Heads-up team: we9re rolling a major update to the Flexible Work Location policy tomorrow. This includes hybrid core hours, remote-first checklist, and a new accommodations flow. Please skim the summary + manager action items and confirm once you9ve completed the microlearning. Summary: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HR/pages/FWL+Update

jon-hr-ops: Thanks Sara. Two asks for managers: 1) fill out the team eligibility spreadsheet by EOD Fri, 2) ensure direct reports complete the short microlearning module (5
mins) and the acknowledgement form. Link to spreadsheet + module below.

emma-legal: Note for EU/UK: added mandatory language around right-to-request flexible working and statutory consultation timelines. Also explicit guidance on data residency for location declarations. Legal diff is on Confluence.

rafael-it: IT will need a stable list of office-eligible devices for hybrid staff and an onboarding checklist for remote hires. Can we get a CSV export of confirmed hybrid eligibilities to sync with device assignment?

zoe-emea: for EMEA managers: we recommend delaying any policy-enforced schedule changes until local works council review completes in DE/FR. I flagged the regional page with dates.

maria-ops-manager: Quick manager question: if an IC switches from remote to hybrid mid-cycle, does that affect their benefits tiering or commuter stipend?

jon-hr-ops: Good Q. Benefit tiers unchanged for the policy window; commuter stipend pro-rated based on start date in the payroll month. I added an FAQ to the summary doc.

ack-bot: Created microlearning assignment "FWL Update: Manager + IC awareness" for all active staff. Due date: 2026-04-10. Track completions here: https://training.redwood.com/assignments/4501

rafael-it: For the CSV export, we9d like the header to be: employee_id,preferred_location,office_eligibility,manager,device_needed,policy_ack_ts

jon-hr-ops: Sample export we9re asking managers to generate (paste into HR ops form):
```
employee_id,preferred_location,office_eligibility,manager,device_needed,policy_ack_ts
24680,Remote,No,maria-ops-manager,Yes,2026-04-03T14:22:00Z
24681,Hybrid,Yes,leo-eng-mgr,No,
```

emma-legal: Also please ensure all location declarations are voluntary and include the opt-out language. For UK staff, we need to capture consultation record if schedule materially changes.

sara-people-ops: Manager action items checklist (short): 1) Review policy summary, 2) Populate team eligibility sheet, 3) Remind reports to finish microlearning + ack form, 4) Submit CSV to HR ops. I9ve added owners on the tracker and estimate 2 weeks for completion.

maria-ops-manager: Will ping my team tonight. Where does the acknowledgement form write back to? Is there an API we can hit?

jon-hr-ops: Acks feed into the HR tracking datastore. IT exposed a simple POST endpoint for bulk uploads; Rafael can share the API key with managers after they request it via the support portal. Endpoint: https://hr-api.internal.redwood.com/v1/acks/bulk

rafael-it: I'll open a request template in the IT support portal and add instructions for managers on scoping device approvals.

zoe-emea: Also sending this to regional leads. One last note: for any manager with >10% of their team changing declared location, file a short impact memo so People Ops can advise on coverage plans.

jon-hr-ops: Copy. We9ll run a weekly digest of completions and call out any missed acks. Planning a live Q&A next Wed at 9am PT; calendar invite to follow.

ack-bot: Export created: https://hr-internal.redwood.com/exports/fwl-ack-2026-04-05.csv (managers with access only).

sara-people-ops: Thanks everyone. I9ll post a final checklist + timeline in #people-ops and ping regional leads directly. :sparkles:
